value.rationale: The Fano cap complex is a canonical smallest projective-plane line-avoiding complex, and the two index-seven geometric stabilizers and Singer normalizer are natural distinguished subgroups. Their exact integral coinvariant torsion distinguishes local versus global symmetry in a way invisible to previously known rational homology characters; it is not an arbitrary parameter slice.
